{{Quote|We did this because it needed to be done. Or, we tried. Everyone suffers. This planet should be no different.|A Believer, on the cult's attempt to wipe out the inhabitants of the planet Caarimon|<ref name="Belly of the Beaast" />}}
'''Crymsin Ost''' was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who became a member of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the latter [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Ost later succumbed to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] and became a member of the [[Believers]], a [[Sith cult/Legends|Sith cult]] that operated from the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]]. In about [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], she traveled to the [[Caarimoos system]] and directed a [[Mission to Caarimon|Believer operation]] to attempt to disperse a [[Anti-Caarite virus|deadly virus]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Caarimon]] and wipe out most of the [[Caarite]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. However, she was attacked by a group of [[Heroes of Cularin|freelance agents]] who defeated her and prevented the infection from being released.

==Biography==
Crymsin Ost was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]],<ref name="Belly of the Beaast" /> and she trained as [[Jedi Guardian/Legends|Jedi Guardian]], a combat-oriented [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] specialization.<ref name="SWRGRCR">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Revised Core Rulebook]]''</ref> At some point Ost lost her sanity and fell to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]]; she abandoned the Jedi and affiliated herself with the [[Believers]], a [[Sith cult/Legends|Sith cult]] that was based in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]]. She eventually became an important member of the cult and, with help from the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] Believer [[Force Adept]] [[Disch'l]], constructed a [[Color/Legends|pink]]-colored [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] for herself.<ref name="Belly of the Beaast" />

In about [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="21 BBY">The ''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]'' states that the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] campaign is set one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] after the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], an event that is dated to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. As the ''Living Force'' adventure ''[[Below the Belt: Philology|Philology]]'' [[Cularin's disappearance|moved]] the campaign forward ten years to the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], ''[[Metatheran Caution: Belly of the Beaast|Belly of the Beaast]]'' is therefore dated to circa [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].</ref> during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Believers embarked upon a plot to [[Death/Legends|wipe out]] most of the [[Caarite]]s&mdash;a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that operated the [[Metatheran Cartel]] [[Merchant/Legends|trade]] organization&mdash;by dispersing a [[Anti-Caarite virus|deadly virus]] on the Caarite [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], [[Caarimon]]. Ost was placed in command of the [[Mission to Caarimon|operation]], and she journeyed to Caarimon aboard a [[Transport/Legends|transport]] that had collected large quantities of the virus from a [[S-Ipsus Believers laboratory|secret Believers laboratory]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Genarius]]. On arrival in the [[Caarimoos system]], Ost's transport docked with the research [[Space station/Legends|station]] [[Creautaa-V]] in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of Caarimon, and she disembarked from the [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] along with the rest of her strike team: Disch'l, the Believer [[Eph]], and [[Melo Centris]], a renowned [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] who had been hired to assist the Believers with their mission. The Believers released a sample of the infection and wiped out all of the installation's Caarite crew, then off-loaded a tank of the virus and ferried it to the lowest level of the station. There, they filled some [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]] with the virus and prepared them for launch in the direction of the planet, and they also rigged the pods with explosives, hoping to crash them into fault lines in the [[Desolation]] region of the world and cause a major cataclysm. Meanwhile, another group of Believers landed on Caarimon and rigged a [[Homing beacon/Legends|homing beacon]] in the Desolation region, and Ost and her crew waited to receive a signal from the [[Transmitter/Legends|transmitter]].<ref name="Belly of the Beaast" />

A group of freelance [[Agent/Legends|agents]] from the Cularin [[Star system/Legends|system]] known as the "[[Heroes of Cularin]]" traveled to Caarimon to investigate the Believer plot, and, after disabling the homing beacon in the Desolation, they boarded the Creautaa-V and confronted Ost's strike team. Ost ignited her lightsaber and moved to attack the operatives, while Disch'l used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to create an [[Mind trick/Legends|illusory]] version of the fallen Jedi, as a distraction. Despite their efforts, Ost and the other Believers were eventually defeated, and the agents prevented the virus from being dispersed on the planet.<ref name="Belly of the Beaast" />

==Personality and traits==
Crymsin Ost was insane and devoted to the ideals of the Believers, and she was willing to commit [[Speciecide|genocide]] in order to further the cult's aims. Like all Believers, she had a [[Tattoo/Legends|tattoo]] on the front of her right [[Limb/Legends|shoulder]] that depicted the [[Almas Sith fortress|Sith Fortress]] on the planet [[Almas]], with a lightsaber handle snapped in two, which formed the base of the [[Fortress/Legends|fortress's]] spire. However, Ost's tattoos were modified such that if she clicked her [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]] in a particular pattern, a fatal dose of [[Poison/Legends|poison]] would spout from sub-dermal implants beneath the tattooed lightsaber handle, giving each halve a red-colored blade.<ref name="Belly of the Beaast" />

==Powers and abilities==
{{RPG|''[[Metatheran Caution: Belly of the Beaast|Belly of the Beaast]]''}}
Ost was used to going into battles with an illusory version of herself beside her, such as the apparition created by Disch'l during her fight against the Heroes of Cularin. She knew how to use the Force to [[Force sense/Legends|sense]] things, to [[Telekinesis/Legends|move objects]], to [[Force healing/Legends|heal]] herself, to improve her combat abilities, and to [[Tutaminis|drain energy]]. In addition, she was familiar with the [[Force power/Legends|powers]] [[Battlemind]], [[Force Enrage|Force rage]], [[Force stealth]], and [[Hatred]], and she was trained in the use of [[Unarmed combat/Legends|martial arts]].<ref name="Belly of the Beaast" />
{{Endgame}}

==Equipment==
Ost wielded a lightsaber, which had a bright-pink blade with traces of red. The weapon had a black-colored [[Steel/Legends|steel]] handle and was ignited via an internal switch, through use of the Force. In addition, she carried a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] as a secondary weapon, and she wore street clothes during her assault on Creautaa-V.<ref name="Belly of the Beaast" />

==Behind the scenes==
Crymsin Ost made her first and only [[canon]] appearance in ''[[Metatheran Caution: Belly of the Beaast|Belly of the Beaast]]'', a [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game|roleplaying]] adventure written by [[Morrie Mullins (real person)|Morrie Mullins]] in [[2003]] that formed part of the [[Metatheran Caution trilogy]] of the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] campaign. During the adventure the player characters [[Roleplaying game|roleplay]] as the Heroes of Cularin, and the amount of Force powers possessed by Ost varies, depending upon the roleplaying experience tier of the players. She can only utilize the powers Drain Energy, Force rage, and telekinesis, or use martial arts when facing off against players in the middle or upper experience tiers, and she can only wield the power Hatred when engaging upper-tier players. As a consequence, when fighting lower-tier players, Ost has to have her lightsaber ignited for her by Disch'l, because she lacks the ability to use telekinesis and thus cannot operate her weapon's Force-activated switch. It is possible for the player character to kill Ost during their encounter with her, and also to loot her lightsaber. If she is captured by the players, she attempts to activate the implants in her tattoos and commit suicide.<ref name="Belly of the Beaast" />
